labels.description: `Tensor` of shape `[d_0, d_1, ..., d_{r-1}]` (where `r` is rank of `labels` and result) and dtype `int32` or `int64`. Each entry in `labels` must be an index in `[0, num_classes)`. Other values will raise an exception when this op is run on CPU, and return `NaN` for corresponding loss and gradient rows on GPU.
constraints: labels must be one of r, int32, int64, NaN, CPU, GPU

logits.description: Unscaled log probabilities of shape `[d_0, d_1, ..., d_{r-1}, num_classes]` and dtype `float16`, `float32`, or `float64`.

output.description: A `Tensor` of the same shape as `labels` and of the same type as `logits` with the softmax cross entropy loss.
